question: Can signed input-times-gradient of SAM2 spatial memory features rank the measured per-tile effects of those same source frames on the same later native prediction?
scope: Exploratory bridge between existing source-local tile-removal utilities and a GT-free attribution signal. The four read pairs were selected from the completed 59-target study, so this is not an independent or confirmatory evaluation.
prompt_policy: first_labeled_frame; only the initialization mask is provided to SAM2

attribution.implementation: Unmodified Captum 0.8.0 InputXGradient; spatial memory features only, before positional addition. Pointer tokens, memory positions, current queries and decoder inputs remain fixed.
attribution.native_mask_support: Mean raw selected-mask logit on the frozen native-positive support; unavailable if support is empty.
attribution.tile_layout: For per-source 64x64 spatial memory, fixed 4x4 grid of 16x16 tokens; row-major tile IDs 0, 5, 10, 15.
attribution.finite_difference_operation: Scale the selected source/tile memory feature content by 1±epsilon. Do not delete the attention entry; positions and pointer tail stay fixed. Compare symmetric finite difference with summed input-times-gradient.
attribution.finite_difference_gate: Report absolute and normalized errors; do not tune epsilon or interpret a flat derivative as a successful usefulness result.

engineering_checks: Native propagated target prediction hash exactly matches the archived native result for all four pairs.
Source frame IDs and temporal slots match the archived native read; captured spatial tensors exactly match those source bank entries.
Native decoder outputs replay within rtol=1e-6 and atol=1e-6 in a separate process.
All four native memory-attention layers execute; gradients and all reported values are finite.
Pointers, positions, decoder inputs, SAM2 parameters and serialized memory remain unchanged during attribution.
Finite differences are diagnostic measurements, not a criterion for efficacy or semantic labels.
limitations: This targeted sample was chosen after inspecting prior utility outcomes; all conclusions are exploratory.
Input-times-gradient measures local confidence/mask-logit sensitivity to feature scaling, not Dice utility or token deletion.
Positive attribution may reinforce a wrong mask; no inference-time selector or segmentation intervention is tested.
No ground-truth masks after the prompt are read by this runner.
output_policy: All run artifacts and temporary staged frames must be under the mounted Drive outputs/experiment folder.
